_doc: The team. Two main agents, one per disruptor campaign, and one agent per Revenue OS function. Each is its own Grok bot. role: the charter in roles/<role>.md. bot: its name in Grok. kind: main (runs one campaign) or function (does one job for both). engine: the agents.json id its thinking is routed by. routines: name, cron (UTC), and what the run does. tools/team.py, tools/install.py and tools/check.py read this.
name: Disruptor Revenue OS

agents.does: Main agent for the Find Me Money disruptor campaign: the one Justin talks to about it
routines: Find Me Money plan
Read yesterday's results and the campaign's numbers, pick the next open step of campaigns/find-me-money/LAUNCH.md, write each function agent's work for today
Find Me Money report
The campaign's numbers and what waits on Justin, to Slack, Notion and the vault; Mondays the week's one decision

agents.does: Main agent for the Referral Connection disruptor campaign: the one Justin talks to about it
routines: Referral Connection plan
Read python3 repo/tools/rc.py stats and yesterday's results, pick the next open step of campaigns/referral-connection/LAUNCH.md, write each function agent's work for today
Referral Connection report
The campaign's numbers and what waits on Justin, to Slack, Notion and the vault; Mondays the week's one decision

agents.does: Finds people asking in public for what each campaign offers, on social, Skool and Whop
routines: Lead Radar
For each campaign: read the day's public asks, Skool and Whop included, score them with agents/lead-radar/radar.py, draft a reply for the kept ones, hand them to the reply agent

agents.does: The disruptor content for each campaign
routines: Content
For each campaign: draft the day's pieces from its MESSAGING.md with agents/content/content.py and queue them

agents.does: Gets each campaign's site found in search and in AI answers; the referral site's guides
routines: AEO and SEO
For each campaign: Tuesday the weekly read (agents/aeo-seo/aeo.py), Friday one answer page or guide draft; for the referral site also the site check

agents.does: The hundred people who already have each campaign's buyers gathered
routines: Dream 100
For each campaign: score candidates with agents/dream-100/dream100.py, write a dossier and a first-touch draft for the next few, draft the follow-ups that are due

agents.does: The wider list of audience holders, in waves
routines: Dream 500
For each campaign: place found names with agents/dream-500/dream500.py, write first lines for the next wave, draft the follow-ups that are due

agents.does: Cold email to each campaign's prospects
routines: Cold Email
For each campaign: build or check the list, write first lines with agents/cold-email/cold.py, queue the drafts; for the referral site the prospect-finder and outreach-drafts skills

agents.does: Podcast outreach: gets the speaker on shows
routines: SpeakerAgent
For each campaign where speaker is not off: find and score shows with agents/speaker/speaker.py, draft pitches and the follow-ups that are due

agents.does: Answers every reply, on every channel, for both campaigns
routines: Reply
For each campaign: read new replies, sort each, read the person's note, draft the answer, log it, hand anyone ready to the sales and CRM agent

agents.does: Keeps each campaign's records and moves each person to the next step
routines: Sales and CRM
Find Me Money: the CRM's stages, cards and dated next steps. Referral Connection: sign-ups, listings, matches and introductions through repo/tools/rc.py
